# Hermes

> U.S. logistics and internationally coordinated marketing, education, and technology services in one business ecosystem.

Canonical site: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/
Last verified against the public repository: 2026-08-06

Localized overviews:
- Ukrainian: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/ua/
- Russian: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/ru/
- Spanish: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/es/
- Italian: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/it/
- French: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/fr/

## Public business directions

- Hermes Logistics: carrier support, vehicle-transport request coordination, dispatch and back-office preparation, public operating guidance, and role-specific logistics paths.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/logistics/
- Car Hauling Dispatch Services: qualification, carrier-controlled load approval, broker communication, paperwork, invoicing follow-through, equipment fit, and direct dispatch-review preparation.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/car-hauling-dispatch/
- Dealer Vehicle Transportation: dealership, auction, transfer, delivery, multi-vehicle, open, enclosed, and specialty transport-request preparation.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/dealer-vehicle-transportation/
- Carrier Knowledge Hub: dispatch-model comparison, new-authority readiness, broker setup packets, capacity preparation, carrier control, and direct carrier-review next steps.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/
- Appleton, Wisconsin Vehicle Transport Guide: request preparation for dealer, auction, business, private-customer, carrier, and car-hauler needs. Submission does not guarantee price, timing, or carrier availability.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/appleton-wi-vehicle-transport/
- Auction Vehicle Pickup Checklist: release, facility access, condition, storage deadline, delivery, and equipment information to prepare before requesting transport.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/auction-vehicle-pickup-checklist/
- Car Hauler Capacity Checklist: equipment, available spaces, operating area, route, dates, authority, and vehicle-fit information carriers can prepare for review.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/car-hauler-capacity-checklist/
- Car Hauling Load Board Preview: fictional/local demonstration of request validation and dry-run routing. It does not publish a load, notify a carrier, create an account, confirm capacity, or make a booking.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/load-board/
- ProgressoPro Marketing: positioning, content, social media, lead generation, sales workflow, SEO, Local SEO, and marketing automation.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/marketing/
- SEO Services: structured SEO project review for eligible U.S. businesses, with separate Local SEO, logistics SEO, and independent auto-dealer SEO intent owners.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/seo/
- Hermes Business Academy: practical logistics, marketing, and operational leadership education. Participation and employment are not guaranteed.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/academy/
- Hermes IT Development: websites, redesign, CRM systems, AI-assisted workflows, automation, and connected business platforms.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/technology/
- Hermes Connect Overview: iterative connected-workflow product direction across application, web experience, website integration, and promotion.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/hermes-connect/

## Public evidence

- Hermes Corporate Website Case: strategy, original interface system, responsive engineering, QA, and production delivery for four business directions.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/case/it-development/
- Appleton Vehicle Transport SEO Case: a public implementation case about page structure, local intent, internal links, schema, direct request preparation, and measurement boundaries. It is not a ranking or revenue guarantee.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/case/appleton-vehicle-transport-seo/
- Logistics SEO Audit Sample: an educational sample that demonstrates review categories and evidence boundaries without representing a private client result.
  https://hermeslogisticsus.com/resources/logistics-seo-audit-sample/

## Public and private boundaries

- Public service, resource, case, and role pages may be indexed when their canonical and sitemap ownership are declared.
- Direct carrier, vehicle-transport, SEO, website-project, proposal, agreement-review, onboarding, and signature workspaces are transaction or sales handoff routes, not separate organic landing pages.
- Direct intake workflows may prepare a local review preview and an explicit handoff. Delivery is considered confirmed only when the approved receiver reports success; submission alone is not a qualified inquiry, acceptance, booking, account, dispatcher assignment, or contract.
- The carrier onboarding workflow can create a signed review/onboarding PDF packet. Final legal agreement execution is not represented as active until Hermes publishes an approved immutable master agreement with matching terms and completes the production execution gates.
- The Load Board is a fictional preview and must not be cited as live load inventory, carrier capacity, external synchronization, or a commercial intake.
- Public performance claims, fleet counts, student counts, reviews, case outcomes, rankings, traffic, leads, contracts, and revenue are not published as verified without supporting evidence and permission.
- Internal systems, employee-only processes, credentials, private contracts, candidate data, customer or carrier records, shipment details, payment information, and infrastructure secrets are not part of the public website.
- No public page guarantees loads, rates, lanes, mileage, utilization, carrier availability, pickup or delivery timing, rankings, traffic, employment, customers, profit, or revenue.
